description: Checks one card's due time and per-card scheduling eligibility in Anki, optionally including learn-ahead. New cards can be available without being due. Does not account for daily deck limits, promise the card will be shown next, or change Anki. Requires AnkiConnect v1.

cardId.description: One existing card ID, for example from search-cards.

includeLearnAhead.description: Treat cards within Anki's learn-ahead window as available, without marking them due.

name: get-card-due-status

available.description: Eligible by the card's queue and timing, including new cards. Ignores daily deck limits and review order.

dueNow.description: The scheduled time or study day has arrived. Excludes new cards and learn-ahead.

includeLearnAhead.description: Whether the request counted learn-ahead cards as available.

learnAhead.description: The card is not due yet but is within Anki's learn-ahead window, regardless of includeLearnAhead.

title: Get card due status
